Bleeding Gums — Causes & Treatment

Why your gums bleed when brushing, and how to fix it before it becomes a bigger problem.

Dr. Siddharth Mehta
BDS MDS · Implant & Laser Dentist, Ahmedabad
📍 Shyamal Cross Road, Ahmedabad🕐 5 min read🦷 Expert Dental Article

Why Do My Gums Bleed When I Brush?

Gum health examination — Dr. Siddharth's Dental Care, Ahmedabad

Bleeding gums are extremely common — and almost always a sign your gums are inflamed, not that you're brushing 'too hard.' At our Ahmedabad clinic, this is one of the most frequent concerns we treat.

The main cause: Gingivitis

Plaque buildup along the gumline irritates gum tissue, causing inflammation and bleeding. This is completely reversible with professional cleaning and improved home care — if caught early.

Stages of gum disease

1️⃣ Gingivitis — bleeding, redness, mild swelling. Fully reversible.

2️⃣ Early periodontitis — gums start pulling away from teeth, forming pockets.

3️⃣ Advanced periodontitis — bone loss, loose teeth, possible tooth loss. Requires intensive treatment.
Professional gum treatment and scaling — Ahmedabad clinic

Other causes of bleeding gums

  • Hormonal changes (pregnancy, puberty)
  • Vitamin C or K deficiency
  • Blood thinning medications
  • Aggressive brushing with a hard-bristled brush
  • Smoking — masks bleeding but worsens underlying disease

Treatment at our Ahmedabad clinic

  • Professional scaling and root planing to remove plaque and tartar
  • Laser gum therapy for more advanced cases
  • Personalised brushing/flossing technique guidance
  • Follow-up cleaning every 3-6 months for gum disease patients

Don't ignore bleeding gums. Left untreated, gingivitis progresses to periodontitis — which can cause permanent bone and tooth loss.
